value.rationale: All three standard associativity invariants and their intersection are classified for every finite Alexander quandle over any field, not just an arbitrary parameter slice. The distinction H2=H and the modular full-nucleus jump explain structural behavior absent in Latin examples. The four-element dihedral jump and arbitrarily large unipotent jumps motivate the precise invariant; no claimed downstream theorem is required.
